## 📎 Project-Specific Notes

> Resonate is a **Flutter/Dart mobile app** (Android + iOS) on **Appwrite** (auth, DB, storage,
> functions), **LiveKit** (WebRTC audio), FCM (push) and optionally Meilisearch. No web target, no
> contracts, no server code here — backend lives in
> [Resonate-Backend](https://github.com/AOSSIE-Org/Resonate-Backend).

### Tooling & Quality
- `warnings` — Dart analyzer via [analysis_options.yaml](analysis_options.yaml): `flutter_lints`
  (103 rules) + `custom_lint` plugin, which activates `riverpod_lint`. Run **both**
  `flutter analyze` and `dart run custom_lint`; the former does not execute plugin lints.
- `warnings_fixed` — two documented suppressions: `invalid_annotation_target: ignore` (freezed) and
  generated files excluded.
- `warnings_strict` — **not met.** `linter: rules:` is empty and no strict language mode
  (`strict-casts`, `strict-inference`, `strict-raw-types`) is enabled.
- `static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities` — Dart has no `bandit`/`eslint-plugin-security`
  equivalent. Cite `flutter analyze` + dependency scanning ([Dependabot](.github/dependabot.yml)).
- `static_analysis_often` — **not met.** [run_tests.yml](.github/workflows/run_tests.yml) runs only
  `flutter test`. Add analyze + custom_lint steps.
- `test_invocation` — `flutter test`, 94 test files, run in CI.
- `test_most` — the % here is an estimate, not measured. Use `flutter test --coverage` before citing it.
- `build_floss_tools` — Android toolchain is fully FLOSS; iOS release builds need macOS + Xcode, so
  annotate as Android-only.

### Dynamic Analysis
- `dynamic_analysis` — **none applied.** ZAP is inapplicable (no web frontend). Options by value:
  `package:integration_test` on device (no `integration_test/` exists; the LiveKit/realtime/background-call
  paths are unreachable by widget tests), crash reporting (no Crashlytics or Sentry —
  `firebase_messaging` is push, not observability), [MobSF](https://github.com/MobSF/Mobile-Security-Framework-MobSF)
  for APK scanning, `leak_tracker` + DevTools profiling.
- `dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions` — **met.** Dart keeps `assert()` in debug/profile;
  `flutter test` runs debug, so the whole suite runs with framework assertions on.
- `dynamic_analysis_unsafe` — N/A for our code (Dart, no FFI), but the binary bundles native
  C/C++ via `ffmpeg_kit_flutter_new`, `whisper_flutter_new` and WebRTC. Justification: mitigated by
  keeping those deps patched, not by running ASan ourselves.

### Security / Backend
- `crypto_*` — no crypto implemented here. Appwrite Auth hashes passwords server-side (Argon2 by
  default — confirm on your instance); LiveKit handles media (DTLS-SRTP). Caveat: `dart:math`
  `Random()` is not a CSPRNG (`Random.secure()` is) — it's used only for display identifiers today.
- `delivery_unsigned` — **open issue.** [constants.dart](lib/utils/constants.dart#L13-L18) hardcodes
  `http://` for Appwrite, LiveKit, Meilisearch and storage URLs; only the host is `--dart-define`-able,
  so production builds still use plain HTTP. `meilisearchApiKey` defaults to `myMasterKey` in source.
- `know_common_errors` — relevant classes are mobile + realtime: token storage (mitigated —
  `flutter_secure_storage` for session material, `GetStorage` only for prefs), Appwrite collection
  permissions, LiveKit token scope/expiry, deep-link and OAuth-callback hijacking, mic/media runtime
  permissions, PII in logs. Evidence: [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md), [PRIVACY-POLICY.md](PRIVACY-POLICY.md).
- Backend hardening belongs in the backend repo's checklist — link across, don't duplicate.

### Release
- `version_unique`/`version_semver` — [pubspec.yaml](pubspec.yaml#L20) `3.0.0+7`: SemVer name +
  build number (Android `versionCode`, iOS `CFBundleVersion`), which must increase every upload.
- Artifacts are signed by construction (Play App Signing / Apple signing).

### Open Items
1. Add `flutter analyze` + `dart run custom_lint` to CI → `static_analysis_often`.
2. Add `flutter test --coverage` → replaces the estimate in `test_most`.
3. Make endpoint schemes configurable / default `https://`, drop the default Meilisearch key →
   `delivery_unsigned`.
4. Add `integration_test/` and/or crash reporting → `dynamic_analysis`.
5. Decide on strict analyzer modes → `warnings_strict`.
